id.description: Unique id to identify exchange rate, i.e. concatenated values of type, currencyIdFrom and currencyIdTo. For instance SALES-EUR-NOK.

Config.title: Config
Config.description: Set of available settings for exchange rate

currencyIdFrom.description: Currency the rate is expressed in — the currency being converted TO. ISO4217.

currencyIdTo.description: Currency being priced — the currency being converted FROM. ISO4217.

exchangeRate.description: Amount of currencyIdFrom equivalent to one unit of currencyIdTo. Multiply an amount in currencyIdTo to obtain currencyIdFrom. Example: currencyIdFrom=SEK, currencyIdTo=EUR, exchangeRate=11.20 means 1 EUR = 11.20 SEK.

createdBy.description: Who wrote the rate: global-exr-scheduler for the automatic ECB import published per store, global-exr-scheduler-level for the automatic ECB import published per level (tenants on the publish-rates-per-level switch), otherwise the user id of the Exchange Rates API caller. Not set by the config portal.

tenantId.description: Tenant the rate belongs to. Written by the Exchange Rates processor; not set by the config portal.

businessUnitId.description: Business unit the rate was written for, when the Exchange Rates processor writes it at business-unit level. Absent at tenant and business-unit-group level, and not set by the config portal.

createdDatetime.description: When the Exchange Rates processor wrote the rate, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Not set by the config portal.
